title: New law: A bill to reauthorize appropriations for certain programs under the Indian Child Protection and Family Violence Prevention Act, and for other purposes. (Public Law 104-16)
summary: S. 441 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-16 on 1995-06-21.

title: New law: A bill to reauthorize appropriations for the Navajo-Hopi Relocation Housing Program. (Public Law 104-15)
summary: S. 349 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-15 on 1995-06-21.

title: New law: To provide that references in the statutes of the United States to any committee or officer of the House of Representatives the name or jurisdiction of which was changed as part of the reorganization of the House of Representatives at the beginning of the One Hundred Fourth Congress shall be treated as referring to the currently applicable committee or officer of the House of Representatives. (Public Law 104-14)
summary: H.R. 1421 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-14 on 1995-06-03.

title: New law: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to permanently extend the deduction for the health insurance costs of self-employed individuals, to repeal the provision permitting nonrecognition of gain on sales and exchanges effectuating policies of the Federal Communications Commission, and for other purposes. (Public Law 104-7)
summary: H.R. 831 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-7 on 1995-06-09.
